# Bundled dependencies

These packages are stored locally so the application does not need a CDN at runtime. Their license texts are in `licenses/`.

| Package | Version | License/source |
|---|---|---|
| Chart.js | 4.4.3 | MIT — https://github.com/chartjs/Chart.js |
| QRCode.js | 1.0.0 | MIT — https://github.com/davidshimjs/qrcodejs |
| Lucide | 0.468.0 | ISC — https://github.com/lucide-icons/lucide |
| jsQR | 1.4.0 | Apache-2.0 — https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR |
| Tailwind CSS browser bundle | 3.4.17 | MIT — https://github.com/tailwindlabs/tailwindcss |
| Font Awesome Free | 6.5.2 | Icons CC BY 4.0; fonts SIL OFL 1.1; code MIT — https://github.com/FortAwesome/Font-Awesome |
| Kanit / Sarabun fonts | Downloaded 2026-10-01 | SIL OFL 1.1 — https://github.com/google/fonts |

Three.js r128 remains in `../factory/` with its existing MIT license. ESC brand images are local copies of the organization's supplied website assets for use in this ESC application; no third-party ownership is claimed.
